scope: Source-only delta for Scrape Save, Unsaved Captures, and Saved Captures. Proposed inventory changes; no runtime result is claimed.

EXT-F-1007.handling: Existing run evidence predates this source change. Preserve history; it does not verify the changed Save behavior or added retry controls.

EXT-F-2009.handling: Existing cases were unverified. Source changes require fresh evidence for affected controls.

changes.feature_name: Capture and manage current page scrape
changes.dependency_class_reason: Save now requires aidream POST /sources/land and Sources data in docproc.processed_documents; the UI contains outage, refusal, and local-retry behavior, but server availability and persistence cross the extension boundary.

controls_changed.label: Save capture
controls_changed.change: Keep the stable ID; redefine as land current capture as a Source, show landing notices and a web-app link on success, and retain a refused/unreachable capture in the device-local unsaved queue. Empty captures show an actionable message.

controls_to_add.label: Open landed Source in web app
controls_to_add.action: Open the newly landed Source from the Save success state.

controls_to_add.label: Review unsaved captures and refusal remedy
controls_to_add.action: Show each device-local capture, its refusal sentence, and available retry/discard actions.

controls_to_add.label: Retry saving an unsaved capture
controls_to_add.action: Retry landing; remove from local queue only after confirmed landing.

controls_to_add.label: Discard unsaved capture with confirmation
controls_to_add.action: Confirm permanent removal of a capture that never landed.

cases_to_add.title: Save a capture as a Source and follow its success state
preconditions: Authenticated user with a device-selected organization; capture contains article text.
steps: Capture a page and Save it.
Observe the saved state and any server notices.
Open the Source in the web app.
expected: A confirmed landing is identified as saved, server notices are visible, and the linked Source opens.

cases_to_add.title: Retain and retry a refused or unreachable save
preconditions: Capture contains article text; use a controlled server refusal or offline condition. Guest mode should receive the sign-in remedy.
steps: Save while landing is refused or unreachable.
Inspect the Unsaved card, reason, and remedy.
Resolve the cause and retry; also verify a repeated refusal leaves the item queued.
expected: The item remains visible and retryable on this device after failure; it leaves the queue only after a confirmed landing. A guest is told to sign in.

cases_to_add.title: Discard an unsaved capture only after confirmation
preconditions: At least one capture remains in the device-local unsaved queue.
steps: Reopen the confirmation, confirm discard, and inspect the queue.
expected: Cancel preserves the item; confirmation removes it and communicates permanent local deletion.

applicability_notes.guest: Scrape is source-visible to guests; Save must be checked for an honest sign-in remedy and device-local retention when server landing cannot authenticate.
applicability_notes.member: Applicable; landing requires the active device organization and server authorization.
applicability_notes.admin: Applicable; same Source landing contract as member.

changes.stale_result_rule: Keep existing EXT-F-1007 cell history and run IDs. Mark these proposed cases unverified when merged; do not mark old Save UI evidence fresh.

changes.dependency_class_reason: Saved Captures now lists, edits, and deletes docproc.processed_documents Sources; loading a full original uses the backend file service. Server and organization/RLS behavior require cross-system verification.

controls_changed.label: Confirm capture deletion
controls_changed.change: Retain stable ID; deletion now removes the Source from Saved Captures and Sources. Verify refusal messaging and that the original web page is unaffected.

controls_changed.label: Edit title
controls_changed.change: This former standalone field is no longer editable; note that title and description edits were replaced by an Article text edit. Retire this control ID or map it to the unified edit case without claiming a title-edit action exists.

controls_changed.label: Edit description
controls_changed.change: This former standalone field is no longer editable; fold its removal into the unified Article text edit case and retire this control ID.

controls_changed.label: Edit article markdown
controls_changed.change: Retain stable ID and update to edit Article text as Source portions; successful edits preserve the original capture and reload the Source.

controls_changed.label: Save capture edits
controls_changed.change: Retain stable ID and verify source edit success, empty-edit refusal, and visible error/retry behavior. The original capture remains unchanged.

controls_changed.label: Show Data tab
controls_changed.change: Data now shows original SoupResult when it loads, otherwise Source structured data; verify data remains available when original is absent or fails to load.

controls_changed.label: Copy capture formats
controls_changed.change: Retain the control ID; validate available copy formats against Source content and the edited text representation.

controls_to_add.label: Open Source in web app
controls_to_add.action: Open the selected Source in the AI Matrx web app.

controls_to_add.label: Load original capture and handle unavailable original
controls_to_add.action: Load the Source original separately; show truthful loading, unavailable, failure, and structured-data fallback states.

controls_to_add.label: Inspect edited Source text and original-preserved notice
controls_to_add.action: Show the edited text as the reader-facing version while communicating that the original capture is unchanged.

controls_to_add.label: Inspect saved versus kept Source status
controls_to_add.action: Distinguish kept from not-yet-kept state in the list and detail view.

cases_to_add_or_revise.title: Edit Source text and inspect original and structured representations
cases_to_add_or_revise.change: Revise existing case; preserve ID and old result provenance. Remove title/description editing expectation; cover unified article text edit, original preservation, original loading/failure fallback, and Data representation.
expected: The reader-facing edited text is reflected after save; the original remains intact; structured data remains inspectable even when the original is missing or unavailable.

cases_to_add_or_revise.title: Open Source in web app and inspect keep state
preconditions: A listed Source is available to the active organization.
steps: Inspect saved/kept status in list and detail.
Open the Source in the web app.
expected: Kept state is represented accurately and the web-app link opens the corresponding Source.

applicability_notes.guest: Saved Captures tab remains signed-in only; retain the negative guest access case.
applicability_notes.member: Applicable for an authorized active organization.
applicability_notes.admin: Applicable for an authorized active organization.

changes.stale_result_rule: Prior EXT-F-2009 cases had no run evidence. New/revised cases begin unverified; no pass is inferred from source or prior inventory status.

backend_dependency.proposal: Treat Source landing/read/edit/delete behavior as a contained cross-system dependency (wave C) before a full backend campaign.
backend_dependency.scope_note: The extension-side containment and recovery paths are in the source; this report does not claim aidream endpoint behavior, database policy, or live persistence was verified.

evidence_reviewed: git diff 53fd39f..ec9f9ab -- ScrapeView, UnsavedCapturesCard, SavedCapturesView, use-scrape, sources route and save helper
unresolved_questions: Confirm whether the inventory merge should retire legacy EXT-F-2009-C12 and EXT-F-2009-C13 IDs outright or preserve them as explicitly removed controls for historical traceability.
Confirm backend endpoint and organization/RLS semantics against the matching aidream source before marking the cross-system dependency reconciled.

actions: Updated EXT-F-1007 and EXT-F-2009 per reviewed source delta; added cases T21-T23 and T05.
Preserved cell run and defect IDs; changed Save case proof remains unverified.
Retained EXT-F-2009-C12/C13 IDs as retired/source-not-applicable with reasons.
